summary: Rookie 1st-rounder took over the lead-back role after Najee Harris tore his Achilles in preseason, then missed 8 games himself (Week 5 ankle injury, IR, returned Week 14). Productive when healthy (737 scrimmage yards, 5 TDs on 156 touches over 9 games) but his 2025 per-game rate is built from a workload-and-injury-interrupted rookie season.

Rookie 2nd-rounder started 7 games after Derek Carr's May retirement (shoulder injury) and Spencer Rattler's early-season benching; went 4-3 down the stretch and drew Offensive Rookie of the Year buzz. Saints have confirmed him as the 2026 starting QB, so his 2025 per-game rate reflects only his starter stretch, not a full season.

No. 2 overall pick and two-way starter (WR/CB) tore his LCL in a noncontact practice injury and had season-ending knee surgery Oct. 31, 2025 after 7 games (28-298-1 receiving). Expected to be fully cleared for football activity within the surgery's 6-month recovery window, i.e. well before 2026 camp. His offensive snap share also competed with defensive (CB) reps as a rookie.

Held out through OTAs/minicamp and into camp in a contract dispute before signing a 3-year, $97M extension in August 2025; later injured his quad diving for a TD in Week 3 and missed 7 games (a career-low 10 played), though he ranked top-5 among WRs in first downs per route run when active.
